title.narrative: RESILIENT. Diversified, sustainable and inclusive value chains in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The Agenzia italiana per la cooperazione allo sviluppo (AICS) RESILIENT project aims to revitalize agricultural production and strengthen community livelihoods in six selected districts of the Tigray Region. Following the severe disruption caused by the two -year conflict, farming households in the target woredas face major challenges related to lost assets, damaged agricultural systems, and weakened local markets. The project is designed to restore and enhance resilience across the agriculture sector through a comprehensive package of inputs, services, and capacity -building interventions. 1. Revitalizing Agricultural Livelihoods: The project supports the recovery and resumption of farming activities by providing: • Essential agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, tools). • Livelihood assets and small livestock. • Micro -credit mechanisms tailored to smallholder needs. • Training and extension services focusing on cereal, fruit, and vegetable value chains. These interventions aim to re -establish productive capacity and strengthen the resilience of households reliant on agriculture for their income and food security. 2. Women's Economic Empowerment: A core component of the project is promoting gender -responsive, climate -smart agricultural practices. The project strengthens the economic agency of women by: • Supporting women -friendly livelihood options such as poultry farming and home gardening. • Strengthening Village Economic and Social Associations (VESAs). • Providing training, agricultural inputs, and access to micro -credit. • Addressing gender -based economic violence by improving women's control over resources. • Enhancing women's resilience and promoting gender equality in local development processes. These efforts ensure that women benefit equitably from post -conflict recovery and can participate meaningfully in decision -making and income -generating opportunities. 3.
